# Accurate Pathology Laboratory

> Trusted diagnostic pathology laboratory in Hadapsar, Pune offering blood tests, full body health checkups, and home sample collection. Open 24×7.

## About

Accurate Pathology Laboratory provides reliable, affordable diagnostic services in the Hadapsar area of Pune, Maharashtra, India. We specialize in blood tests, health checkups, and pathology services with home sample collection and WhatsApp report delivery.

## Services

- Complete Blood Count (CBC) — ₹250
- HbA1c & Blood Sugar — ₹350
- Thyroid Profile (T3, T4, TSH) — ₹400
- Lipid Profile (Cholesterol) — ₹450
- Full Body Master Health Checkup (85+ Parameters) — ₹1,499
- Advanced Diabetes & Metabolic Profile — ₹799
- Senior Citizen Comprehensive Panel — ₹1,899
- Home Sample Collection — Free with select packages
- 24×7 Laboratory Testing
- Reports on WhatsApp
